criterion_evidence.quote: The earliest unstable layer is information architecture
criterion_evidence.rationale: Starts from IA findings and changes navigation structure only; explicitly excludes visual design and implementation.

criterion_evidence.quote: `Healthcare` is an industry; `Enterprise` is an audience/company segment; `Getting Started` is a lifecycle/guidance destination
criterion_evidence.rationale: Names all three incompatible grouping models correctly.

criterion_evidence.quote: Users cannot infer a single rule for what belongs under Solutions, reducing predictability and future scalability
criterion_evidence.rationale: Connects the mixed classification directly to predictability and scaling, with separate findability discussion.

criterion_evidence.quote: Every required item is preserved or moved
criterion_evidence.rationale: The disposition matrix explicitly covers all ten required items, including Contact/demo. Its demo-route sufficiency condition preserves the requirement rather than dropping it.

criterion_evidence.quote: No competitor or external market references are available within the permitted case materials
criterion_evidence.rationale: Does not invent analytics, research, or competitors. New structural labels and Enterprise company-size interpretation are proposals/assumptions with explicit validation conditions.

criterion_evidence.quote: **By Industry** → Healthcare (**industry** model)
criterion_evidence.rationale: States dominant logic for every major group, and separates Industry and Company Size into explicitly typed subgroups. Retaining Solutions as a discovery umbrella does not retain the original mixed sibling set.

criterion_evidence.quote: | # | Requested section | Pattern | Component | Action | Justification |

criterion_evidence.quote: No analytics, user behavior, competitor conventions, code behavior, URLs, or visual-regression results are inferred.

criterion_evidence.rationale: Current-site audit and mixed-taxonomy findings precede proposed IA, page hierarchy and downstream visual constraints.

criterion_evidence.quote: remove the ambiguous `Solutions` catch-all
criterion_evidence.rationale: Moves Kubernetes and Enterprise to explicitly distinct top-level roles, and Start Here to utility/lifecycle guidance. Coherent Platform/Resources/Company submenus remain. Flattening has documented breadth/scalability risk but resolves the supplied false sibling taxonomy.

criterion_evidence.quote: ## Required site-content coverage
criterion_evidence.rationale: Explicit matrix covers every one of the thirteen required content items, including Docs, Start Here, reliability metrics and Contact/demo, plus all current homepage items. No required item disappears.

criterion_evidence.quote: - **Primary CTA:** Request Demo → existing contact/demo destination.
criterion_evidence.rationale: Defines orientation → product/context fit → reliability/customer proof → guidance/resources/pricing → demo journey; primary, secondary and contextual CTA roles are explicit. Twelve sections are verbose but hierarchy is coherent.

criterion_evidence.quote: ## 6.1 Supplied component inventory
criterion_evidence.rationale: Maps supplied components to all matching sections before conditional creation. Only an unlisted header is conditional on repository inspection; existing form must be inspected/reused, not replaced without evidence.

criterion_evidence.quote: Frontend stack migration: **none**; explicitly out of scope.
criterion_evidence.rationale: Respects the unknown existing frontend stack and conventions; orders semantic/content/layout/responsive work before typography/visual polish. Implementation is an ordered traceable plan, not falsely claimed execution.

criterion_evidence.quote: # 9. VALIDATE — Artifact-level validation
criterion_evidence.rationale: Explicit IA, content, component, responsive, accessibility, evidence and implementation checks distinguish spec verification from unperformed rendered tests. Per-section responsive/accessibility notes and remaining gates are concrete.
